reason: Re-opened the packet and the live revision 1552800: under 善勝敵者不與 the Heshang Gong commentary reads 善以道勝敵者，附近以仁，來遠以德，不與敵爭，而敵自服也, and under 善用人者為之下 善用人自輔佐者，常為人執謙下也. Legge’s rhymed lines He who vanquishes ... Keeps from his foes apart and He whose hests men most fulfil ... humbly plies his art are those two lines (不與, 為之下). The paraphrase (winning by benevolence and virtue, foes yielding without contest, keeping below those he uses) is carried by those words; Wang Bi here gives only 不與爭也, so the choice is sound. verse.js ok (at [67]); entry-check ok at the 45-word cap.
